controles.affirmation: Citation 10-Q : "partially offset by an increase in discounts and other discounts in connection with joint business plans..." et argument selon lequel la direction reconnait 'une augmentation des remises accordees'
controles.verbatim_source: These increases were partially offset by volume and other discounts in connection with joint business plans and other strategic partnerships in an effort to drive future growth. (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Le verbatim a ete altere : le filing ecrit 'volume and other discounts', pas 'an increase in discounts and other discounts'. Le 10-Q ne dit nulle part que les remises ont augmente. Reformuler : 'la hausse du CA a ete partiellement compensee par les remises de volume et autres remises liees aux joint business plans et partenariats strategiques, destinees a soutenir la croissance future'.

controles.affirmation: L'action collective consolidee 'In re The Trade Desk, Inc. Securities Litigation' vise 'la periode du 9 mai 2024 au 12 fevrier 2025'
controles.verbatim_source: Plaintiffs filed a First Amended Consolidated Class Action Complaint on August 15, 2025. The First Amended Complaint purports to be brought on behalf of those who purchased or otherwise acquired the Company's publicly traded securities between November 15, 2023 and August 8, 2025.
controles.correction_proposee: La periode du 9 mai 2024 au 12 fevrier 2025 est celle des plaintes initiales, superseded. La plainte operative (First Amended Complaint) couvre le 15 novembre 2023 au 8 aout 2025 et ajoute un grief de delit d'initie (Section 20A). A noter aussi, en faveur de la these : la motion to dismiss a ete REJETEE le 17 mars 2026 et un proces est fixe au 16 mai 2028 - element absent de l'ATT.
